Narrative and Plans for
Type | Zoning Map Amendment for

2618 W. 71" Street. Chicago

Rezoning from B1-| to a B2-3

The subject property is improved with a 2 story building. The applicant plans to re-
develop the existing building as a four unit residential building. Applicant needs zoning
change to a B2-3 district to meet the bulk and density standards of the zoning ordinance.
A. Proposed Land Use: 4 unit residential building.

B. Project floor area ratio: 2.2 FAR.
C. Project Density (Lot area per dwelling unit): 3,277 +4=819 SF per dwelling unit.

D. The amount of off-street parking is 2 parking spaces.
E. Setbacks:
Front: 0’
West: 3°
Rear: 30”
East: 0°
F. Building height: 20°
OPTIONAL RELIEF UNDER SECTION 17-13-0303 D:
An administrative adjustment to reduce required parking to two parking spaces. Pursuant to
section 17-13-1003-EE parking reduction for transit served locations, we seek an adjustment to

reduce the parking requirement from 4 spaces to 2 spaces for existing building with 4 dwelling

units and a 2-car garage.
